simplifyAccountsPreparation.description: Simplify accounts preparation for small limited companies registered in England.
steps: Collect bank transactions and other financial inputs through guided data collection.
Prepare draft accounts according to HMRC requirements.
Allow user review and approval of final accounts.
Enable electronic filing of returns following HMRC procedures.
simplifyAccountsPreparation.companyType: Small limited companies registered in England

ensureComplianceWithEnglandHMRC.description: Ensure compliance with England HMRC accounting and filing standards.
rules: Accounts must follow HMRC format and content requirements.
Only small limited companies registered in England are supported.
No support for complex corporate structures or audits.

provideClearUserFriendlyGuidance.description: Provide clear, user-friendly guidance throughout the accounts preparation and filing process.
features: Simple user review and approval workflow.
Status indicators for progress and compliance.

helpUsersOptimizeTaxManagement.description: Help users optimize tax management efficiently within the scope of general efficiency suggestions.
suggestions: No complex tax advice or manual bookkeeping support.
